product_metadata.title: RE-Chargeable Automatic Soap Dispenser | 22oz Dish Soap Dispenser for Kitchen Sink | 650ml Hand Soap Dispenser Bathroom | Touchless Infrared Sensor Battery Hand Soap Dispenser
features: Fewer Refills Needed - This automatic dish soap dispenser boasts a high capacity of 22oz (650ml) which means you won't have to refill it as often. The large container size makes for a more convenient and long lasting product, and the best option for your kitchen or bathroom.

No More Touching - Using this touchless soap dispenser may help to minimize the transfer of dirty elements from person to person, which may happen with typical hand pump dispensers and soap bars. Whether you're washing dishes or hands, the Dock will help you scrub more efficiently and hygienically.

Save Money On Batteries - This rechargeable soap dispenser has a 1200mAh lithium battery. Since it's rechargeable, it saves you from the hassle of having to replace batteries, allowing it to remain among your kitchen accessories for countertop as it charges.

Minimize Wastage - The volume control on this electric soap dispenser lets you control how much soap is dispensed. You can set it to release 1ml-5ml of liquid soap using the dedicated buttons. With a compact size and high volume, it can be a great option as a soap container for traveling; a great amazon find!

Important Note - This liquid soap dispenser is designed to be used with non-granular and non-foaming liquid soap. This is not made for use with hand sanitizer and liquid soap with high alcohol content. Es la mejor opción para lavar platos de cocina or lavar las manos.
